title: Concept: PHP-FPM status page disclosed
description: The PHP-FPM status page is served, so the process manager configuration and live worker metrics are readable by any caller.
applicability: Responses served by PHP-FPM with the status path enabled.
risk: The page discloses the pool name, manager mode and queue depth, which tells an attacker how much concurrency the deployment has and when it is saturated; LOW because the data is operational metrics.
